result.summary: The 2022 page replaces the 2021 Ohana/four core values framing with new mission and values text: 'Our mission is to deliver it' (connection), 'We act as trusted advisors' (trust), and new sections on equal opportunities, net zero, stakeholder capitalism and Pledge 1%. The 2021 'Nothing is more important... than the privacy' and 'Ensuring that all voices are welcome' statements are removed.
